name: Luna
care: A secure garden and a daily walk will help Luna thrive.
description: Luna is bright, affectionate and always ready for a walk. She settles beautifully after exercise and loves being close to her people.

name: Milo
care: Milo is happiest indoors with a sunny perch and daily play.
description: Milo is a gentle window-watcher who warms up quickly with a quiet hello and a feather toy.

name: Nala
care: Nala needs structured exercise and would prefer to be the only pet.
description: Nala is an adventurous, people-focused dog who would love weekend hikes and a confident routine.

name: Saffron
care: Saffron has a sensitive stomach and follows a simple veterinary diet.
description: Saffron is poised, sociable and happiest when she can choose between a garden view and a cosy lap.
